limitations: This is a static producer census, not verification that every conditional/tick actually executes.
Heals built through helper-returned HealInfo are listed at their composite literal; callers forwarding a value are not duplicated as producers.
Direct field-write detection is limited to variables syntactically initialized from a HealInfo literal in the same file; pointer aliases/reflection are not inferred.

prior82CensusReview.result: The prior classic census did not miss any HealInfo composite-literal count in this pinned tree (82 matches 82). It did miss the effective Xilonen source amount because Src and Bonus are assigned after constructing the HealInfo literal inside each delayed heal task. That source producer is listed under postConstructionWrites. The previous literal-only census is therefore incomplete as a producer inventory.
